apertif.title: Aperitif
apertif.text: Complete The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign once on any difficulty.

unshattered.title: Unshattered
unshattered.text: Achieve every ending in this campaign.

a_strong_silent_type.title: A Strong, Silent Type
a_strong_silent_type.text: Finish The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign without voluntarily triggering any codex entries.

colour_outside_the_lines.title: Colour Outside the Lines
colour_outside_the_lines.text: Skip both The Twisted Hollow and The Longest Night during a single playthrough.

life_of_the_party.title: Life of the Party
life_of_the_party.text: Complete The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with each resident at Relationship Level 2 or higher.

dancing_queen.title: Dancing Queen
dancing_queen.text: Share a dance with 4 different residents during The Second Evening prelude.

audrey_3.title: Audrey III
audrey_3.text: Complete a scenario engaged with a Poisonblossom having 10 or more overgrowth on it.

hold_onto_your_potatoes.title: Hold on to your Potatoes!
hold_onto_your_potatoes.text: Complete Written in Rock with both a resident and the Prismatic Shard asset under your control.

dream_home_breakover.title: Dream Home Breakover
dream_home_breakover.text: Complete Hemlock House with 10 locations in the victory display.

settling_the_score.title: Settling the Score
settling_the_score.text: Defeat the Thing in the Depths in The Thing in the Depths.

here_crabby_crabby.title: “Here, Crabby Crabby!”
here_crabby_crabby.text: Make the Limulus Hybrid flip at least 8 times during The Lost Sister.

a_different_kind_of_string_ops.title: A Different Kind of Sting Ops
a_different_kind_of_string_ops.text: Complete The Silent Heath without spawning the Brood Queen.

wait_theres_no_shrouded_shrine.title: Wait, There’s No Shrouded Shrine?
wait_theres_no_shrouded_shrine.text: Survive The Twisted Hollow in Standalone Mode until you reach at least Darkness Level 10.

bear_necessities.title: Bear Necessities
bear_necessities.text: Defeat the Ursine Hybrid in The Longest Night using only scenario card effects.

lets_do_the_time_warp.title: Let’s Do the Time Warp!
lets_do_the_time_warp.text: Complete the Lambs to the Slaughter Resolution in Prelude: The Final Evening.

oblivion_shmoblivion.title: Oblivion Shmoblivion
oblivion_shmoblivion.text: Win the Fate of the Vale with each Cosmic Emissary enemy in the victory display.

high_dive.title: High Dive
high_dive.text: Sacrifice yourself for the Vale in Fate of the Vale.

best_friends_forever.title: Best Friends Forever!
best_friends_forever.text: Reach Relationship Level 6 with the following residents:

know_your_place.title: Know Your Place
know_your_place.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with Mother Rachel at Relationship Level 3.

heart_of_steel.title: Heart of Steel
heart_of_steel.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with Judith Park at Relationship Level 7.

holding_out_for_a_himbo.title: Holding Out for a Himbo
holding_out_for_a_himbo.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with Theo Peters at Relationship Level 7.

captivating_scream.title: Captivating Scream
captivating_scream.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign as Patrice Hathaway.

line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
line_in_the_sand.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

hemlock_expertise.title: Hemlock Expertise
hemlock_expertise.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign on Expert difficulty
